verdict.rationale: Genie lets users ask natural-language questions and get answers grounded in their organization's data, returning SQL, result tables, and visualizations. It is also available to business users through Genie One, including on mobile. AI/BI dashboards offer AI-assisted authoring for sharing insights, and Genie Code provides inline suggestions while working directly with Unity Catalog tables. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of insight quality, and evidence of proactively surfaced data insights (anomalies or trends) beyond question-and-answer and authoring assistance.
